newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - BP puts bought in dividend play.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - BP puts bought in dividend play.

text.p: British Petroleum options were active on Friday, with 3,250 deep out-of-the-money puts being purchased along with the underlying shares, ahead of the stock going ex-dividend on Monday, dealers said.
Theoretically, dividend plays are profitable no matter what happens to the stock because the holder of the stock and puts can claim the dividend and then exercise the puts to sell the stock.
Dealers said 3,250 January 800 puts were bought along with the underlying shares, which were trading at 637p at 1507 GMT, up 3p.
British Petroleum is set to pay a net dividend of 5p, or a gross dividend 6.25.
Elsewhere, dealers also noted the sale of December 390 calls on Lloyds TSB at 6p.
The trade will be profitable as long as the shares, holding flat at 380p, remain below 396p through December expiry on December 18. Lloyds shares were last above that level only three weeks ago.
Activity in other stock options was sparce, with a few hundred call options trading in British Airways, National Power and British Petroleum.
